create_Qwen3ASRRealtimeBuffer: create a Qwen3ASRRealtimeBuffer with a sampling rate and segment duration to accumulate and yield audio segments
write_audio_to_buffer: write audio chunks to a Qwen3ASRRealtimeBuffer and read out 5-second segments when enough samples are buffered
build_Qwen3ASRRealtimeMultiModalProcesso: build a Qwen3ASRRealtimeMultiModalProcessor that expands audio_pad tokens to match audio feature lengths for MRoPE positioning
run_buffer_realtime_audio: run buffer_realtime_audio to stream audio chunks and yield TokensPrompts with multi-modal audio data for realtime transcription
get_speech_to_text_config: get a SpeechToTextConfig from a model config by extracting the feature extractor sampling rate for speech-to-text inference
